rules.notes: automated_tools_allowed=false: Policy explicitly states 'Any form of automation' is prohibited under Scope Exclusions. mass_scanning_allowed=false: Derived from explicit automation prohibition. bucket_listing_allowed=true: Not addressed in policy; using safe default (our own compliance allows listing). bucket_download_allowed=false: Not addressed in policy; using safe default (conservative). cve_age_min_days=30: Policy states 'Public Zero-day vulnerabilities that have had an official patch for less than 1 month will be awarded on a case by case basis' — interpreted as 30-day minimum, though awarded case-by-case. requires_ownership_proof=true: Policy requires testing only accounts you own or with explicit permission. safe_harbor=true: Policy explicitly states 'The Gold Standard Safe Harbor applies' (https://hackerone.com/8x8-bounty/safe_harbor). Additional notes: (1) No test credentials provided for most products. (2) Researchers must tag HTTP requests with X-HackerOne: [username] in User-Agent. (3) Use [username]@wearehackerone.com alias within applications. (4) Report unique vulnerabilities once across related domains (assumed single fix). (5) DoS, spamming, social engineering, and physical attacks are explicitly prohibited. (6) Missing headers, cookie flags, SSL issues, CSRF on unauth forms, clickjacking, rate limiting, general low-severity scanner output are all out of scope. (7) Vulnerable libraries require working PoC. (8) Credential stuffing out of scope.

raw_policy_excerpt:
At 8x8, we help companies get their employees, customers and applications talking to make people more connected and productive no matter where they are in the world. At 8x8 we value security and recognize the importance of ensuring the integrity and confidentiality of global communications.

## Scope Exclusions
While researching, we'd like to ask you to refrain from:
* **Any form of automation**
* Any activity that could lead to the disruption of our service (DoS)
* Spamming
* Social engineering (including phishing) of 8x8 staff or contractors
* Any physical attempts against 8x8 property or data centers
* Missing security headers (eg. HSTS, CSP, SPF, DMARC)
* Missing flags on cookies
* SSL issues (expired certs/weak ciphers/key-size/BEAST/CRIME)
* Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) on unauthenticated forms or forms with no security impact
* Clickjacking
* Rate limiting or brute force issues
* General low severity issues reported by automated scanners
* Attacks requiring MITM or physical access to a user's device
* Vulnerable libraries or dependencies absent a working Proof of Concept
* Comma Separated Values (CSV) injection
* Vulnerabilities only affecting users of outdated or unpatched browsers [Less than 2 stable versions behind the latest released stable version]
* Software version disclosure / Banner identification issues / Descriptive error messages or headers
* Tab-nabbing
* Self XSS without further security impact
* Public Zero-day vulnerabilities that have had an official patch for less than 1 month will be awarded on a case by case basis.
* Credential Stuffing: out of scope and will not be rewarded.

## Testing Identification
* Please utilize your [username]@wearehackerone.com alias when submitting information within the applications.
* Include your HackerOne username in each HTTP request: X-HackerOne: [H1 username] appended to User-Agent.

## Safe Harbor
The Gold Standard Safe Harbor applies (https://hackerone.com/8x8-bounty/safe_harbor).

## Disclosure Policy
* Let us know as soon as possible upon discovery of a potential security issue.
* Please do not discuss vulnerabilities outside of the program without proper coordination and express consent from 8x8.
* Make a good faith effort to avoid privacy violations, destruction of data, and interruption or degradation of our service.
* Only interact with accounts you own or with explicit permission of the account holder.
* Follow HackerOne's disclosure guidelines.

## Response Targets
* Time to first response (from report submit) - 1 business days
* Time to triage (from report submit) - 2 business days
